verdict.rationale: Riveter documents a public REST API with an OpenAPI spec covering enrich, datasets, scrape, search, and named endpoints such as /enrich, /runs/{id}, /runs/{id}/result and /datasets. It also ships an official Go SDK and documents API behaviors like webhook_url callbacks, dry_run, and max_credits. The probe 404s only hit openapi.json-style paths, while the spec is published at /openapi.yaml, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Riveter API lets you enrich data, build datasets, scrape webpages, quickly search the web, and extract data from complicated websites programmatically.
